text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, or TDD, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When they make changes, they can run the tests again to see if anything breaks. Without tests, it is easy to introduce bugs and much harder to improve the code safely.
